text: Refund Policy (US): Customers may return physical hardware within 30 days of delivery for a full refund if original packaging is intact.
Refund Policy (EU): Under EU consumer directives, customers have a 14-day cooling-off period for digital goods and 30 days for hardware.
Refund Policy (Enterprise): Custom enterprise contracts are non-refundable after deployment sign-off unless SLA uptime drops below 99.5%.
API Rate Limits: Free tier accounts are capped at 60 requests per minute. Pro tier accounts allow 600 requests per minute.
Authentication: All API calls require a Bearer token passed in the Authorization header. Tokens expire every 24 hours.
Q1 Churn Analysis: Q1 enterprise churn was 4.2%, primarily driven by missing SSO integrations and slow onboarding times.
Q2 Churn Analysis: Q2 enterprise churn dropped to 2.8% following the release of SAML 2.0 support and automated migration scripts.
Q3 Churn Analysis: Q3 enterprise churn rose slightly to 3.1% due to pricing tier restructuring affecting mid-market renewals.
Data Residency: European customer data is stored exclusively in AWS eu-west-1 (Dublin) with AES-256 encryption at rest.
Data Residency (US): US customer data is stored exclusively in AWS us-east-1 (N. Virginia) with AES-256 encryption at rest and multi-AZ replication.
